choose.when: left join kb_apps r on p.resource_code = r.app_code
left join kb_models r on p.resource_code = r.model_code
left join kb_provider_accounts r on p.resource_code = r.code
left join kb_routing_rules r on p.resource_code = r.rule_code
left join kb_routing_consumers r on p.resource_code = r.consumer_code

mapper.sql: p.id, p.resource_type, p.resource_code, r.id AS resource_id, p.rate_limit_policy_code, p.quota_policy_code

choose.when: select app_code from kb_apps where id = #{resourceId}
select model_code from kb_models where id = #{resourceId}
select code from kb_provider_accounts where id = #{resourceId}
select rule_code from kb_routing_rules where id = #{resourceId}
select consumer_code from kb_routing_consumers where id = #{resourceId}

mapper.insert: insert into kb_resource_traffic_policies(resource_type, resource_code, rate_limit_policy_code, quota_policy_code) values(#{resourceType}, #{resourceCode}, #{rateLimitPolicyCode}, #{quotaPolicyCode})
